purpose: Name architectural asset domains, their reusable components, and the style families that can attach geometric shaping ledgers to those components.

domains.role: Edge protection, boundary, procession, balcony, stair, and terrace rail assets.

components.role: Large terminal, corner, or turn post.
Repeated support post within a railing run.
Small vertical support between rails.
Top rail or grip profile.
Lower rail tying posts and balusters together.
Panel, grille, tracery, or guard field between posts.
Joinery pocket or connector where rails enter posts.
Small support, brace, or ornamental connector.
Top closure for a post, wall, or rail.
Terminal ornament at the top of a post or rail run.

domains.role: Vertical circulation assets and their structural or ornamental parts.

components.role: Horizontal stepping surface.
Vertical face between treads.
Side support profile for a stair run.
Flat transition platform.
Projecting front lip of a tread.
Vertical core for spiral or winding stairs.
Sloped top rail following a stair run.
Sloped or vertical support along stairs.
Side trim board or stone strip along steps.
Tapered stair step around a turn.

domains.role: Openings, frames, tracery, glass, and reveal assets.

components.role: Vertical side of an opening.
Bottom horizontal support or weathering member.
Top horizontal opening member.
Curved or pointed top of an opening.
Vertical divider between lights.
Horizontal divider between lights.
Patterned stone or modeled linework within an opening.
Flat or colored transparent panel.
Inset side surface around an opening.
Projecting trim above an opening.

domains.role: Door leaves, structural surrounds, thresholds, and portal trim.

components.role: Main door plane.
Vertical member of a framed door.
Horizontal member of a framed door.
Inset or raised field inside a frame.
Vertical side of a door opening.
Horizontal top support over an opening.
Arched or pointed portal surround.
Bottom crossing member.
Surface hinge or ironwork strap.
Trim or stonework framing the door.

domains.role: Profiled edges, lips, bands, cornices, bases, and decorative runs.

components.role: Small flat separating band.
Rounded convex moulding.
Small round moulding or repeated dot.
Concave moulding.
Convex quarter-round moulding.
S-shaped moulding profile.

Ogee variant with convex over concave curve.
Repeated small block under a cornice.
Projecting top moulding or crown.

domains.role: Overhead ribs, cells, bosses, vault webs, domes, and patterned ceiling fields.

Curved or folded surface between ribs.
Central or intersection ornament.
Hanging ornament or downward element.
Radial surface segment of a dome.
Tiered cell lifted from a 2D plan.
Recessed ceiling panel.
